title: I will enter His gates
lyrics_original: I will enter His gates with thanksgiving in my heart;
I will enter His courts with praise.
I will say this is the day that the Lord has made.
I will rejoice for He has made me glad.
He has made me glad, He has made me glad,
I will rejoice for He has made me glad.
He has made me glad, He has made me glad,
I will rejoice for He has made me glad.

bible_verses.telugu: కృతజ్ఞతార్పణలు చెల్లించుచు ఆయన గుమ్మములలో ప్రవేశించుడి కీర్తనలు పాడుచు ఆయన ఆవరణములలో ప్రవేశించుడి ఆయనను స్తుతించుడి ఆయన నామమును ఘనపరచుడి.
bible_verses.english: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.

bible_verses.telugu: ఇది యెహోవా ఏర్పాటు చేసిన దినము  దీనియందు మనము ఉత్సహించి సంతోషించెదము.
bible_verses.english: The LORD has done it this very day; let us rejoice today and be glad.

bible_verses.telugu: ఎందుకనగా యెహోవా, నీ కార్యముచేత నీవు నన్ను సంతోషపరచుచున్నావు నీ చేతిపనులబట్టి నేను ఉత్సహించుచున్నాను.
bible_verses.english: For you make me glad by your deeds, LORD; I sing for joy at what your hands have done.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for the gift of this brand-new day. I choose to enter Your presence with a grateful heart, leaving behind my doubts and distractions. Fill me with Your joy and help me see Your goodness all around me today. You are the true source of my gladness, and I praise You for Your unending faithful love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for the gift of this brand-new day. I choose to enter Your presence with a grateful heart, leaving behind my doubts and distractions. Fill me with Your joy and help me see Your goodness all around me today. You are the true source of my gladness, and I praise You for Your unending faithful love. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Every day offers us a fresh invitation to step into God's presence with gratitude. When we choose thanksgiving over worry, our hearts align with the joy of His kingdom. Today is a gift directly from His hands, shaped by His love and care for us. As you sing, let praise open the doors of your heart, celebrating the deep and abiding gladness that Christ brings into your life.
